checklist.Checklist item: For each interface, governed evidence shall identify either a recognized standard with an unambiguous applicable specification or full custom behavior. AMBA, AHB, APB, AXI, I2C, SPI, LIN and UART are examples, not an exhaustive list. A family name, acronym or vague reference alone shall not establish standard coverage. Verify the role, subset or mode, deviations, sidebands and integration constraints under the following items; valid standard coverage shall replace, not duplicate, checks of standard-defined signal semantics, interpretation, handshakes and timing. Non-standard, partially identified or undocumented deviating behavior shall receive full custom-interface checks
